name: Boys' Doubles
subtitle: 4 teams · Knockout + final
rulesFormat: 5 teams play a single round robin — every team plays each of the other four teams once (10 matches total).
All round-robin matches are a single set, played to 15 points.
Scoring is rally-point: a point is scored on every rally regardless of who served.
Standings are ranked by matches won. In the event of a tie, the team with the greater point difference is ranked higher.
The top 2 ranked teams advance to the Final.
The Final is the best of 3 sets, every set played to 15 points.
If the score reaches 14-14 in any set, play continues until one side gains a 2-point lead, or reaches a cap of 17 points, whichever comes first.
